source_findings.actual: All passes except DEPTH and MOTION_VECTORS increment VIEWPORT_RENDER_INFO_TYPE_VISIBLE draw calls, including SHADOW.
Shadow primitive counts are separately recorded under VIEWPORT_RENDER_INFO_TYPE_SHADOW.

correction: The earlier inference that zero reported shadow draws weakens a caster explanation is retracted. On this GLES implementation zero in that draw category is not evidence that no shadow pass was rendered. Earlier raw measurements/hashes remain unchanged.
consequence: D004 striation cause remains unknown. Constant-normal/native-material agreement does not isolate shadows. Future explicitly declared caster/light-shadow controls should record shadow primitives and exact settings. No new engine experiment or production change performed.
